newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Five die in clan feuding in S.Africa's Zulu region.
newsitem.headline: Five die in clan feuding in S.Africa's Zulu region.

text.p: Gunmen have shot dead five people and torched 15 huts in South Africa's Zulu heartland in an attack linked to faction fighting, police said on Tuesday.
They said the unidentified gunmen had opened fire with AK-47 rifles on a rural settlement at Nongoma in northern KwaZulu-Natal province on Monday.
"The suspects opened fire with AK-47 rifles, killing five people. The motive is believed to be related to faction fighting," police said in a statement, adding there had been no arrests.

Despite a reduction in political clashes between supporters of President Nelson Mandela and Zulu Chief Mangosuthu Buthelezi in KwaZulu-Natal, clan feuds sparked by squabbles over boundaries, grazing and chieftaincy continue to dog the region.
